keys.$comment: sources/simulation_components/steady_simcomp.f90:126-129 `name` is never read and this%name is never set, so two `steady` components always collide on Neko's name-uniqueness check (neko src/simulation_components/simcomp_executor.f90:273-283) at the first step, whatever `name` the entries carry; at most one `steady` entry per case cannot be written with the whitelisted keywords (no contains).

tol.description: Convergence tolerance: the maximum over u, v, w, p (and the scalar) of ||f_new - f_old||_L2 / (dt * domain volume) must not exceed it. Default 1.0e-6.

log_frequency.description: Steps between log lines; any integer but 0 (a negative value logs like its absolute value). Default 50.
log_frequency.$comment: steady_simcomp.f90:128 reads it with json_get_or_default and :276, :335 only use mod(tstep, log_frequency) == 0, so 0 divides by zero and nothing else aborts.

scalar_coupled.description: Include the scalar in the convergence test. Default false.
